title: Samsung Technical School – A CSR Initiative - We care for the girl child
description: Samsung cares for the dreams of girls in India. See how Samsung Technical School in ITI Jaipur changes life of Seema Nagar, a girl from a small village in Rajasthan. Watch and share her inspiring story. #SapneHueBade   There are 20 Samsung Technical Schools across India. 10 of them are a joint collaboration between Samsung India and the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME). 10 other schools are in ITIs in partnership with the State Governments of Delhi, Bihar, Kerala, Rajasthan and Bengal.  For more information: http://www.samsung.com/in/microsite/sapne-hue-bade/  For any Customer service (SVC) & support related queries, call us at: 1800 40 SAMSUNG (7267864) Know more: https://www.samsung.com/in/multi-device-experience/ Support: https://www.samsung.com/in/support/  Community: https://r2.community.samsung.com/t5/India/ct-p/in Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SamsungIndia/ Twitter: https://twitter.com/samsungindia  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/samsungindia/

asr.full_text: Why, Kailash? You're preparing the ertrig? Sir, don't worry. She should be my daughter. Deivarji, it's your daughter. Let me check from inside. Not daughter. You are my son! Is she here, dear!? Yes...! So, she is your daughter, Patek! Diwo.. Is she a place for girls to work? Get the hell out of here! Get out! ...as one of the gods in this world. He's always with girls. Get the hell out of here. No! The current is fast. A golden day. A golden voice in a youthful song. The world wants to cross. And now the He needs this much money to do it, right? That's good, then... Take it. Please, dear. Have you had a good meal? I haven't had a good meal since I woke up. It's good, then. You won't have to keep going, will you? No, no. You can't go. "...do your youth, if you want." Listen. "...if you think that it is the time of the life." Salaash Salaash can't be called an heir. Go son. How's your study? "...neither will you stop your flight." Nobody can fly it You are the light in light. You bright a lamp. Your beautiful smile, makes people go mad. Hello, Mr. Sukar. Come here, come. What happened to the light? Check it in the cash register. Mr. Suran, do you want to check the lights? Wait, let me check. Seema, what are you doing close to the generator. Get out. You escaped. Hey! Yes? Wow, brother! You saved a face today. Meet him, my friend, Cima Nagar, Madam Engineer. I'll find a good man for him next. Ask him to wait there. He wants to open his own service centre first. Wonderful, my dear. You're right. You have three sons. No, good job. You are right brother. I have three sons now. No brother, you and I are children now. Two sons of mine, and an affectionate daughter. May You lead us to a higher path

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Samsung CSR story about technical training and opportunities for girls in India. The training-focused subtitle, description of Samsung Technical Schools, and sampled technical-work scene support an educational and human-interest narrative, while the visible Samsung branding does not establish a deceptive promise, payment request, data-collection mechanism, or transaction outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Education, technical training and related operational work are central: the description identifies Samsung Technical Schools and the supplied frames show a training/workshop context involving a Samsung appliance.
